subject: QCRYPTO proof-of-work custody chain

compute_operations.note: Do not infer compute quantity from hashes, commit count, CI wall time, or artifact size.

electrical_energy.note: No contemporaneous meter-backed kWh record is present in the frozen custody bundle.

resource_time.note: No authoritative accelerator-hour/CPU-core-hour ledger is present in the frozen custody bundle.

labor_time.note: Conversation/commit timestamps are not treated as measured labor-hours.

data_processed.note: Repository/artifact byte size is not automatically treated as total data processed.

monetary_cost.note: No cost model is back-filled from compute, energy, or time without an explicit provenance-bearing transformation.

output_count.note: Commits, files, workflow artifacts, and test outputs are countable provenance objects but are not a universal measure of work.

inference_prohibitions: CI duration -> resource time without runner telemetry
compute quantity -> kWh without an explicit measured/benchmarked model
kWh -> monetary cost without an explicit tariff/model
kWh -> emissions without an explicit emissions-factor model

future_measurement_model.rule: Keep native quantities native; relate non-equivalent quantities only through explicit evidence-bearing transformations.

claims_boundary: The custody hashes and Sigstore evidence support artifact integrity/provenance, not the magnitude or physical/economic form of historical applied work. Missing historical resource telemetry remains NOT_RECORDED rather than estimated retroactively.
